ancientwarriorsrebelliouslufeng.name: Ancient Warriors - Rebellious Lu Feng
ancientwarriorsrebelliouslufeng.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by controlling the highest ATK "Ancient Warriors" monster on the field (even if it's tied). You can only Special Summon "Ancient Warriors - Rebellious Lu Feng" once per turn this way. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied), also you cannot activate monster effects the turn you activate this effect, except "Ancient Warriors" monsters'. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if your opponent controls a monster with the highest ATK on the field (even if tied): Give control of this card to your opponent.

anotherversestratios.name: Anotherverse Stratios
anotherversestratios.desc: ''This war god from the otherworld has trod countless battlefields beneath his armored feet. If you want his glory, come and get it!''

aquarianalessa.name: Aquarian Alessa
aquarianalessa.desc:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, they discard 1 random card.

aromagardening.name: Aroma Gardening
aromagardening.desc: If you Normal or Special Summon an "Aroma" monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can gain 1000 LP. When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while your LP are lower than your opponent's: You can Special Summon 1 "Aroma" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Aroma Gardening" once per turn.

bigjaws.name: Big Jaws
bigjaws.desc: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked: Banish it.

brotherhoodofthefirefisthawk.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Hawk
brotherhoodofthefirefisthawk.desc: If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect): You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell Card directly from your Deck. While you control a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Card, all "Fire Fist" monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF.

dicedungeon.name: Dice Dungeon
dicedungeon.desc:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Dimension Dice" from your Deck to your hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can activate this effect; each player rolls a six-sided die and applies the result to all monsters they control, until the end of this turn.
● 1: Lose 1000 ATK.
● 2: Gain 1000 ATK.
● 3: Lose 500 ATK.
● 4: Gain 500 ATK.
● 5: Halve their ATK.
● 6: Double their ATK.

dragunityknightromulus.name: Dragunity Knight - Romulus
dragunityknightromulus.desc:
2 Dragon and/or Winged Beast monsters, except Tokens
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Dragunity" Spell/Trap or 1 "Dragon Ravine" from your Deck to your hand. If a Dragon monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck to a zone this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 Dragon or Winged Beast monster from your hand in Defense Position, but for the rest of this turn, its effects (if any) are negated and it cannot be used as Link Material. You can only use each effect of "Dragunity Knight - Romulus" once per turn.

fabledragin.name: Fabled Ragin
fabledragin.desc:
1 "Fabled" Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can draw until you have 2 cards in your hand.

fakeexplosion.name: Fake Explosion
fakeexplosion.desc: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Monsters cannot be destroyed by this battle. After damage calculation, Special Summon 1 "Summon Reactor・SK" from your hand or Graveyard.

fallingdown.name: Falling Down
fallingdown.desc: Activate this card by targeting an opponent's monster; equip this card to it. Take control of it. Destroy this card unless you control an "Archfiend" card. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: You take 800 damage.

fortuneladyevery.name: Fortune Lady Every
fortuneladyevery.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Spellcaster monsters
This card's ATK/DEF become its Level x 400. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Increase this card's Level by 1 (max. 12), then, you can banish 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can banish 1 other Spellcaster monster from your GY; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Fortune Lady Every" once per turn.

indioradoomvoltthecubicemperor.name: Indiora Doom Volt the Cubic Emperor
indioradoomvoltthecubicemperor.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 "Cubic" monsters you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If Summoned this way, this card gains 2400 ATK. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand: Inflict 800 damage to your opponent. If this card in your possession is sent to your Graveyard by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect): You can target up to 3 "Cubic" monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon them, then you can add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

kingoftheswamp.name: King of the Swamp
kingoftheswamp.desc: This card can be used as a substitute for any 1 Fusion Material whose name is specifically listed on the Fusion Monster Card, but the other Fusion Material(s) must be correct. You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

koakimeiruice.name: Koa'ki Meiru Ice
koakimeiruice.desc: During each of your End Phases, destroy this card unless you send 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" from your hand to the Graveyard or reveal 1 Continuous Spell Card in your hand. You can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy 1 Special Summoned monster on the field.

luckychance.name: Lucky Chance
luckychance.desc: Once per Chain, if a monster effect is activated that tosses a coin once: Call heads or tails. If your call matches the coin toss for that monster effect, draw 1 card immediately after that effect resolves.

luckytrinket.name: Lucky Trinket
luckytrinket.desc: This creature may look slim and weak, but it's protected by a mystical force.

magistustheurgy.name: Magistus Theurgy
magistustheurgy.desc: Target 1 "Magistus" monster you control; equip it with 1 "Magistus" monster, except a Level 4 monster, from your Extra Deck, GY, or face-up field. If you have at least 1 each "Magistus" Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters in your GY, you can equip it with 1 non-"Magistus" Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster from your Extra Deck, instead. You can only activate "Magistus Theurgy" once per turn.

mirrorbarrier.name: Mirror Barrier
mirrorbarrier.desc:
Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to it as an Equip Card with this effect.
● Once per battle, during the Battle Step, if the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster: You can destroy that opponent's monster.
If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 "Armament Reincarnation" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mirror Barrier" once per turn.

nadirservant.name: Nadir Servant
nadirservant.desc: Send 1 monster from your Extra Deck to the GY, then add 1 "Dogmatika" monster or "Fallen of Albaz" from your Deck or GY to your hand, that has ATK less than or equal to that sent monster in the GY, also, for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck. You can only activate 1 "Nadir Servant" per turn.

neoflamvellshaman.name: Neo Flamvell Shaman
neoflamvellshaman.desc: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle while you have 3 or more "Flamvell" monsters in your Graveyard, select 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard and remove it from play. If your opponent does not have any Spell Cards in their Graveyard when this effect activates, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

paladinofdarkdragon.name: Paladin of Dark Dragon
paladinofdarkdragon.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Dark Dragon Ritual". At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Red-Eyes" monster from your hand or Deck, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick". You can only use this effect of "Paladin of Dark Dragon" once per turn.

pharaonicprotector.name: Pharaonic Protector
pharaonicprotector.desc: The mummy of a soldier that has been guarding the royal family for thousands of years. Even now, its spirit does not allow anybody to trespass.

robotbusterdestructionsword.name: Robot Buster Destruction Sword
robotbusterdestructionsword.desc: You can target 1 "Buster Blader" you control; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster, Spell/Trap Cards that are already face-up on your opponent's side of the field cannot activate their effects. You can send this Equip Card to the Graveyard; the monster that was equipped with this card gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

rokketcoder.name: Rokket Coder
rokketcoder.desc: If this card would be used for the Link Summon of a "Borrel" monster, you can treat this card as a Dragon. You can only use each of the following effects of "Rokket Coder" once per turn. If a Cyberse monster you control would be used as Link Material for a "Code Talker" monster, this card in your hand can also be used as material. If this card you control would be used as Link Material for a "Borrel" monster, 1 DARK monster in your hand can also be used as material.

saionthevaylantzarcher.name: Saion the Vaylantz Archer
saionthevaylantzarcher.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card to your Main Monster Zone in its same column, also you cannot Special Summon non-"Vaylantz" monsters for the rest of this turn, except from the Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Saion the Vaylantz Archer" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If you control this Special Summoned card: You can target 1 Effect Monster on the field; toss a coin and if the result is heads, negate its effects, or if the result is tails, halve its ATK. If this card in the Monster Zone moves to another Monster Zone: You can target 1 card on the field; toss a coin and if the result is heads, destroy it, or if the result is tails, return it to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Saion the Vaylantz Archer" once per turn.

scraprage.name: Scrap Rage
scraprage.desc: Activate only during damage calculation, if a Defense Position "Scrap" monster on the field is being attacked. It gains 2000 DEF and is destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase.

shiningelf.name: Shining Elf
shiningelf.desc:
2 Level 2 monsters
When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; that monster(s) loses 500 ATK.

spacetimetranscendence.name: Spacetime Transcendence
spacetimetranscendence.desc: Banish 2 or more Dinosaur monsters from your GY; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand or GY whose Level equals the total Levels of those banished monsters, but it cannot attack this turn.

wattjustment.name: Wattjustment
wattjustment.desc: Equip only to a Level 3 or lower Thunder-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK, also its effects are negated. Each time it inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

whitebeardtheplunderpatrollhelm.name: Whitebeard, the Plunder Patroll Helm
whitebeardtheplunderpatrollhelm.desc: During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 "Plunder Patroll" monster from your Extra Deck with the same Attribute as a monster your opponent controls or is in their GY, and if you do, equip this card you control to it. If this card is sent from the hand or Monster Zone to the GY: You can activate this effect; Special Summon 1 "Plunder Patroll" monster from your Deck, except "Whitebeard, the Plunder Patroll Helm", also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Plunder Patroll" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Whitebeard, the Plunder Patroll Helm" once per turn.

zombyra.name: Zombyra
zombyra.desc: When this card declares an attack: You lose 500 LP, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK. When a monster is destroyed by battle: You can equip this card from your GY to the monster that destroyed that monster, then you can destroy the 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). The equipped monster's name becomes "Zombyra", also its effects are negated. When the equipped monster declares an attack: Its controller loses 500 LP, and if they do, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK.
